nodes.label: abrirModalCantidad()
nodes.rationale: Quantity defaults to 1 so the most common sale stays one-tap fast.

nodes.label: cargarMisVentas()
nodes.rationale: Filters to today's sales (Lima day) client-side only; full history remains in DB and /kpis.

nodes.label: productosPorDefecto()
nodes.rationale: Default view shows the month's best sellers in order; falls back to full catalog if none so the screen is never empty.

nodes.label: Cierre de caja diario
nodes.rationale: One closing per day with withdrawals (retiros) and physical cash count (cuadre); owner marks each as revisado. Cannot be reopened once closed.

nodes.label: Datos de prueba DEMO (sembrar_datos_prueba.py)
nodes.rationale: Seeded products are prefixed 'DEMO - ' so --limpiar deletes only demo data and never real catalog/sales.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL local (5432) o Docker (5433)
nodes.rationale: Docker container uses port 5433 to avoid colliding with an existing Windows PostgreSQL service on 5432.

nodes.label: Conexion directa Power BI a PostgreSQL
nodes.norm_label: conexion directa power bi a postgresql
nodes.rationale: Power BI reads normalized tables directly with a read-only user; no special API endpoint needed. App KPIs are only a summary.

nodes.label: Bootstrap del primer dueno (crear_dueno_inicial.py)
nodes.rationale: Users can only be created via API by a logged-in dueno, so the first owner must be created by a standalone script.

nodes.label: Pruebas automaticas con SQLite temporal
nodes.rationale: Tests use a temporary SQLite DB so the real PostgreSQL is never touched.

nodes.label: Reporte de cierre por correo (Gmail SMTP)
nodes.norm_label: reporte de cierre por correo (gmail smtp)
nodes.rationale: Uses Python stdlib SMTP to avoid new dependencies; if SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD are empty the closing still works and only a log warning is emitted (graceful degradation).

nodes.label: Roles: dueno, contador, vendedor
nodes.rationale: Role matrix: vendedor sees only own sales and no KPIs; only dueno creates/deactivates users and marks closings as revisado.

nodes.label: Modal confirmar cierre de caja (conteo fisico)
nodes.norm_label: modal confirmar cierre de caja (conteo fisico)
nodes.rationale: Asks for physical count and shows expected cash before final close because the caja cannot be reopened.
